environment: Claude Code cloud container; outbound HTTPS only via the environment egress proxy (policy chosen in environment settings)
summary: Same result as round 12 (data/civic/astana/round12-verified/network_audit.json): every Kazakhstan official/news host tried, OSM and en.wikipedia.org are denied by the egress policy (CONNECT 403 / EGRESS_BLOCKED). No page body of any candidate source could be read. Diagnostics stopped after 9 hosts by curl and 3 URLs by WebFetch; the other 70 registered URLs were not retried one by one (same hosts, same policy).
circumvention: Not attempted: no web archives, mirrors, reader proxies, cached-page services or other proxies were used for blocked hosts.
how_to_unblock: Environment settings -> Network access: broader level, or add gov.kz, www.gov.kz, astana.gov.kz, inform.kz, www.inform.kz, kazpravda.kz, zakon.kz, www.zakon.kz, bes.media, vechastana.kz to Allowed domains (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cloud-environments#network-access). Alternatively a person opens the page in their own browser and attaches the saved text with tools/r13.py attach (see RUN.txt).
